notes.title: UPDATES for some fixture request!
notes.content: I so sorry for the previous version on some sound problem. We have lowered the sound for some of the sfx sound. And also we added a skip trigger for the end trailer. Please do update the game by uninstalling and reinstall the current game. Sorry for the inconvenience! Please do send me message if you need help! Thanks!

notes.title: Our Game Finally Release! Thanks to our supporter and Valve!
notes.content: Thankfully to all our supporters whom help us along the way! We hope to get some review to help us improve our game for the 2nd Episode! We will strive and listen to your guidance and feedback seriously. I look forward to all who will help us to grow and give us a chance to create the game we love passionately! We as Indie Dev Thank you all!
